newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded, front bids slip below 9 p/th.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded, front bids slip below 9 p/th.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures did not trade on Friday morning.

Bids and offers were posted in all 12 contract months by the close of the morning session. Front months July, August and September were all bid at 8.95 pence a therm at the close with offers at 9.30 pence, 9.35 pence and 9.55 pence respectively.
In every month of the contract, bids and offers straddled the previous settlement level by the close, indicating a lack of direction in the market.
